name: test_authored_test_discard
description: Undo a rejected agent-authored test attempt (restore or remove each touched path) so it can never ride along on a later, unrelated repair commit.

repoPath.description: Absolute path to the git repository the rejected attempt's touched paths are restored/removed in.

paths.description: The touched paths reported by test_authored_test_validate to discard: a tracked path is reverted to HEAD, an untracked one is removed.

discarded.description: The paths actually restored or removed, sorted.
